objective: To save the ASN of ASN Crossdock Creation (X8) when the user confirms [Submit ASN]: the mapping in TB_R_INSTRUCTION is written into the existing ASN tables TB_R_DAILY_ORDER_MANIFEST (status Created) and TB_R_DAILY_ORDER_PART.
The screen does not wait for the result: it shows the Submit ID and the batch writes its messages to the existing log (Log Monitoring). In case any error occurs, nothing is saved (all-or-nothing).

steps: X8 generates the Submit ID, writes the start message to the log (LOG1) and starts this batch. The screen returns to the delivery plan and shows the Submit ID.

Read the rows of the Submit ID from TB_R_INSTRUCTION (one Supplier Code + Plant). Take the ASN No from the existing numbering and auto generate one Case No per case by checking the last sequence (existing last sequence table; format as existing).
Insert TB_R_DAILY_ORDER_MANIFEST (status Created) and TB_R_DAILY_ORDER_PART (existing tables, refer Data Edit Mapping); write ASN_NO / CASE_NO back to TB_R_INSTRUCTION.

No error: commit, write the result (LOG2) and end (LOG3) messages. Error: roll back, release the mapping (delete the rows from TB_R_INSTRUCTION, PO_MAPPED_FLAG back to 'N', MAPPED_QTY of TB_R_PRA_DAILY_ORDER_MAPPED reduced again), write the error (LOG4). Exit.

items: Submit ASN runs as a batch so the screen does not wait; the user sees the Submit ID and checks the result in Log Monitoring. No success popup is shown on X8.
The log follows the existing Supplier System log (same table and columns); the Submit ID is the key to find the run.
All-or-nothing: on error nothing is saved and the mapping made by [Create ASN] is released (rows deleted from TB_R_INSTRUCTION), so the units can be selected again.

The ASN is saved in the existing tables TB_R_DAILY_ORDER_MANIFEST / TB_R_DAILY_ORDER_PART; the case number is auto generated by checking the last sequence kept in the existing last sequence table (format as existing, not detailed here).
The submit process (Submit ID, batch call, log) follows the existing ASN submit of Supplier System.
